0.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_000
0.description: A child of man enters Anyx Trine... Interesting...
0.translation_description: Un essere umano entra ad Anyx Trine... Interessante...

3.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_010
5.description: I am Sehn Y Toh. My brothers and sisters are as one under Hraesvelgr. We purge this place of all who bear us ill will.
5.translation_description: Sono Sehn Y Toh. I miei fratelli e le mie sorelle sono uniti sotto Hraesvelgr. Scacciamo da qui chiunque nutra cattive intenzioni nei nostri confronti.

6.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_011
6.description: We seek quiet and calm. Those who deny us will be met with fangs and claws.
6.translation_description: Cerchiamo pace e quiete. Chi ce le negherà si troverà di fronte zanne e artigli.

7.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_012
7.description: Heed me, mortal. Should you disturb the peace of our home, we will know...
7.translation_description: Ascoltami, mortale. Se turberai la pace della nostra casa, ce ne accorgeremo...

8.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_020
8.description: Anyx Trine is the work of man in ages past.
8.translation_description: Anyx Trine è opera degli uomini di un tempo.

9.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_021
9.description: But man has long forgotten the fruits of his labor.
9.translation_description: Ma da molto tempo l'umanità ha dimenticato i frutti del proprio lavoro.

10.name: TEXT_REGDRA2ANYXTRINE_00285_SEHNYTOH_000_022
10.description: The origins of Anyx Trine are not our concern. These grounds are silent. They suit our needs. Anyx Trine is our home now.
10.translation_description: Le origini di Anyx Trine non ci riguardano. Qui regna il silenzio, e questi luoghi fanno al caso nostro. Ormai Anyx Trine è la nostra casa.
